scope: 租房装修入住较长说法
author: gap-fill
review_scope: Single AI author reads every selected word and records positional polyphone decisions. Words are longer than six characters, so curate_lexicon.py select() does not accept them; merge_lexicon_batch.py appends the frozen rows. Not an independent human linguistic review and not a bulk import.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; default agreement is not a review decision
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative category bands before native evaluation; no measured corpus frequencies or tuning to public answer ranks.
